question: How are MS-ADS applicants considered for merit scholarships?

pipeline_flatrag.answer:
Based on the retrieved context, MS-ADS applicants are automatically considered for merit scholarships once they apply to the program, with no separate application required [1]. Early applications are highly encouraged, and it is recommended that candidates submit their applications ahead of the early deadline to maximize their chances of securing a scholarship [1][2].

Sources:
1. [Tuition Fees Aid | Financial Aid](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/tuition-fees-aid/)
2. [Tuition Fees Aid | The Data Science Institute Scholarship, MS in Applied Data Science Alumni Scholarship](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/tuition-fees-aid/)
